notes.title: Farmageddon: A Cattle Royale is now available for Mac!
notes.content:
Hey folks! It's been a bit! With a few other projects in the works, it's been a struggle dedicating the time I'd like to Farmageddon, but I FINALLY managed to get the game to work on Mac OS. 

My next goal is to get the game released on the App Store for iOS and Google Play for Android. I don't have a set time frame for this, but I'm hoping to have it ready by the end of the year.

In the meantime, stay tuned for the Halloween and Holiday events!

Oh, and check out the new trailer I made to give an idea of the game!

[previewyoutube=jdjhNgGp24o;leftthumb]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jdjhNgGp24o[/previewyoutube]

Stay tuned!

-Solidplasma

notes.title: Long time, Moo see!
notes.content:
Hey, folks. Solidplasma here.

As some of you know, I've been streaming a lot on [url=twitch.tv/solidplasma]twitch[/url] lately, sometimes showing off my own games, but usually playing other stuff. I definitely haven't given up on game dev, and I'm already working on my next project, but for anyone who's ,made a game, you know how hard it is to keep working on a game after it's declared "launched". The thing about Farmageddon is that it's a community oriented game. When people are playing it, they show up in each others games, and even become bosses for each other. But that requires people to be playing it regularly, and I haven't been marketing it enough to get a consistent playerbase. 

That's why I'm pushing an update to the game using a native compiler. It should now run smoother, and I've also added some minor quality of life fixes. But that's not all. I want Moo-I mean you!

If you're a YouTuber with at least 2k Subscribers, or an Affilated/Partnered Twitch streamer with 10 or higher CCV, reach out to me either via email (evan at solidplasmastudios dot com), [url=https://discord.gg/a4FPnwn]Discord,[/url] or [url=http://twitter.com/solidplasma]Twitter[/url]. I'll be giving away copies of Bedlamball to those selected (Currently 10 USD on Steam).

And if you enjoy the game, please leave a review! It SERIOUSLY helps.

Let's make this game as a-MOO-zing as it can be!

Love,

Solidplasma

Happy spooky season, everyone! We've got some exciting news!

We've been working on an autumn update to the game! I've been holding off on posting too much, because most of the seasonal assets aren't ready yet, but we hope to have it out by the end of the month! This update will include new skins, 3 new passive items, and seasonal graphic changes!

Here's a look at one of the new items, the Crystal Bull, which works kind of like the lens of truth in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38068271/61fcd0ee8f53f69e289d1cf7136825a258acfb41.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38068271/61fcd0ee8f53f69e289d1cf7136825a258acfb41.gif[/img][/url]

notes.title: Version 1.15 released and the future of the game!
notes.content:
Long time, no updates. Moo me.

In all seriousness though, I've been wanting to update the game for a while, and I apologize for the delay. As the project lead and only client programmer, I've got my work cut out for me. This update includes, new leaderboards, bug fixes and various quality of life improvements. If you encounter any errors, please shoot me and email at evan (at) solidplasmastudios (dot) com.

I would love to do a Halloween update with new skins and items. If you enjoy the game and want to see this, spreading the word really helps, as does streaming it. The game [url=https://www.twitch.tv/directory/game/Farmageddon%3A%20A%20Cattle%20Royale] has its own category on Twitch[/url]. Every little bit of exposure helps.

Until next time!

-Solidplasma

notes.title: Version 1.14 released!
notes.content:
So, uh, apologies to anyone who tried to launch the game the past couple of days and got an error. It should now be resolved. Here's a list of the changes/fixes!

[list]
[*] Fixed a crash upon trying to play the game.
[*] We've added a new Leaderboard: Pasture Protectors! This leaderboard shows the top 10 steam account who have had a cow in the divine pasture the longest!
[*] Recent Victors Leaderboard should no longer reset with the seed
[*] Farmers should drop hearts more freqeuently
[*] Various minor Quality of Life and bug fixes
[/list]

Thanks for playing the game!

-Solidplasma
